blockers: Resolve held readings for this instrument.

method: MiniLM embeddings suggest device identity; human review is mandatory. Ordinary least squares fits reference = slope × observed + intercept on fit rows only. Check rows are not used to fit. Compare raw and corrected mean absolute errors on those same held-out rows; require all within supplied tolerance, and release use readings only inside the fit range. This small worksheet is not traceability, uncertainty analysis or calibration certification.
